nodes.label: Maṇimēkalai · heroine of the Tamil epic

claims.subject: tamil_vasanthamālai
claims.summary: The poem calls Vasanthamālai Mādhavi’s friend when Chitrāpathi summons her.
claims.speaker: Narrator
claims.note: A named friendship in the poem, not a link to Agastya personally.

claims.subject: tamil_chitrapathi
claims.summary: Chitrāpathi asks Vasanthamālai to go to Mādhavi and report the city’s talk.
claims.speaker: Narrator and Chitrāpathi
claims.note: The direction is within the Indra-festival narrative, downstream of the text’s Agastya reference.

claims.subject: tamil_kovalan
claims.summary: Ettikumaran speaks of Maṇimēkalai grieving for her father Kovalan.
claims.speaker: Ettikumaran
claims.note: Maṇimēkalai the heroine has a separate node from Maṇimēkalai the text.

claims.subject: tamil_kannagi
claims.summary: Mādhavi describes Kaṇṇaki as grieving for her husband Kovalan.
claims.speaker: Mādhavi
claims.note: This source presents the relationship through Mādhavi’s retelling.

claims.subject: tamil_madhavi
claims.summary: Mādhavi says she entered Aṟavaṇa Aṭikaḷ’s monastery, related her grief, and received his counsel.
claims.speaker: Mādhavi
claims.note: This records Mādhavi’s report of an encounter, not an Agastya encounter.

claims.subject: tamil_sudhamathi
claims.summary: The translation identifies Sudhamathi as Mādhavi’s friend while she strings garlands with Maṇimēkalai.
claims.speaker: Narrator
claims.note: Source-local name spelling follows Hart’s translation.

claims.subject: tamil_sudhamathi
claims.summary: Sudhamathi goes with Maṇimēkalai to the flower garden after Mādhavi sends her for fresh flowers.
claims.speaker: Narrator
claims.note: This is a narrated episode involving the heroine, not the text node.

search_log.outcome: Checked translated narrative and Tamil line locators for Chitrāpathi, Vasanthamālai, Mādhavi, Maṇimēkalai, Kovalan, Kaṇṇaki, Aṟavaṇa Aṭikaḷ, and Sudhamathi.

notes: The work and its heroine must remain distinct graph nodes. These connections arise in the same Tamil epic as an Agastya mention; they do not imply that Agastya meets these people.
